accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.description: Every account your books use, grouped by type. Sub-accounts roll up into their parent.
accounts.emptyBody: Add your first account, or start from an industry template.
accounts.systemHint: LedgerNest relies on this account. You can rename it, but not remove it.

hints.systemType: A system account's type can't change.
hints.typeLocked: Accounts with sub-accounts keep their type.
hints.parent: Sub-accounts roll up into their parent and share its type.
hints.code: Letters, digits, dots and dashes, like 1100.01.

hints.currencyLocked: The currency can’t change once the account has entries.

confirm.archiveBody: It won't be offered for new entries. Its history stays, and you can restore it at any time.
confirm.deleteBody: It has no entries, so it will be removed for good.

errors.code_taken: Another account already uses this code.
errors.name_taken: Another account already has this name.
errors.parent_type: A sub-account must have the same type as its parent.

errors.used_by_tax: A tax rate posts to this account. Change the tax rate first.

periods.title: Financial years
periods.description: Your books are kept by month. Close a month when its books are final: nothing dated in it can then be posted or changed.
periods.emptyBody: Add this financial year to start recording entries.

confirm.closeBody: Nothing dated in this month can be posted, changed or reversed until it's reopened.
confirm.reopenBody: Its entries can be changed again. Reopening is recorded in the audit log with your reason.

errors.not_contiguous: Financial years must follow on from each other without gaps.
errors.earlier_open: Close earlier months first: months close in order.
errors.later_closed: Reopen later months first: months reopen in reverse order.
errors.no_retained_earnings: The Retained earnings account is missing, so the year can’t close.

yearEnd.closeBody: {{month}} closes, and a year-end entry on its last day brings every income and expense account to zero against Retained earnings.
yearEnd.profit: A profit of {{amount}} moves to Retained earnings.
yearEnd.loss: A loss of {{amount}} moves to Retained earnings.
yearEnd.nothing: There are no income or expense balances to move.
yearEnd.reopenBody: {{month}} reopens, and the year-end entry {{number}} is reversed so the year can be corrected and closed again.

journals.title: Journal entries
journals.description: Every transaction as balanced debits and credits. Drafts can change; posted entries are final and corrected by reversal.
journals.emptyBody: Record your first transaction: what came in, what went out.
journals.reverseBody: A new entry with the exact opposite amounts will be posted and linked to this one. This entry stays as it is.
journals.reverseDateHint: Pick a day in an open month, e.g. today, to correct a closed month.
journals.deleteBody: It hasn't been posted, so it will be removed for good.
journals.postedHint: Posted entries are final. To correct one, reverse it.
journals.draftHint: Drafts can be saved unbalanced; posting needs debits equal to credits.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.hint: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB: receipts, invoices, statements.
attachments.wrongType: Attach a PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP file.

problems.no_rate: A foreign-currency line has no exchange rate for this date.

errors.unbalanced: Debits and credits must be equal.
errors.too_few_lines: An entry needs at least two lines.
errors.period_closed: This date is in a closed month. Reopen it, or use a date in an open month.
errors.no_period: There's no financial year for this date. Add it under Financial years.
errors.account_archived: A line uses an archived account.
errors.account_not_found: A line uses an account that no longer exists.
errors.posted: Posted entries can't be changed. Reverse it instead.
errors.not_posted: Only posted entries can be reversed.
errors.already_reversed: This entry has already been reversed.
errors.is_reversal: A reversal can't itself be reversed. Post a new entry instead.
errors.type_mismatch: That file isn't the type it claims to be.
errors.missing_account: Choose an account for every line.
errors.tax_group_archived: A line uses an archived tax group.
errors.tax_group_not_found: A line uses a tax group that no longer exists.
errors.tax_too_small: This amount is too small to carry the tax.
errors.closing_entry: This entry closed a financial year. Reopen the year’s last month instead, which reverses it.
errors.currency_required: This account is kept in a foreign currency: enter the line in that currency.
errors.currency_mismatch: Only foreign-currency accounts take foreign amounts.
errors.no_rate: There is no exchange rate for this date. Add one under Currencies, or type the rate on the line.
errors.amount_too_small: This amount is too small to show in the base currency.

fx.noRate: No {{code}} rate on or before {{date}}: add one under Currencies, or type it here.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Built from posted entries only, in {{currency}}.
reports.pickAccount: Choose an account to see its ledger
reports.noLines: No posted entries in these dates.

tax.title: Tax summary
tax.hint: Posted entries only. Credit notes and reversals are netted.
tax.empty: No taxed entries in this period
tax.emptyBody: Pick a tax group on a journal line and it shows up here once posted.

aging.title: Aging
aging.hint: Open invoices or bills as the books stood on the day, by how long they’ve been due.

empty.receivables: Nobody owes anything on this day
empty.payables: Nothing owed to vendors on this day

aging.emptyBody: Try another date, or come back once invoices and bills are recorded.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.description: GST, VAT or sales tax: the rates you charge and the accounts they post to.
taxes.emptyBody: Add a rate such as VAT 20%, then a group that lines can pick.
taxes.emptyBodyGst: Set GST up in one step from India’s official slabs, or add your own rates.
taxes.groupsHint: What a journal line picks. A group charges one or more rates together.
taxes.ratesHint: Each rate posts tax on sales to a liability and tax on purchases to input credit.
taxes.noInputAccount: None: purchases reduce the sales tax account

hints.rate: A percentage, e.g. 20 or 0.125. It can’t change later.
hints.outputAccount: A liability: the tax you owe.
hints.inputAccount: An asset: tax you paid and can claim back.

validation.name: Enter at least 2 characters.
validation.rate: Enter a rate between 0 and 100, with at most 4 decimals.
validation.outputAccount: Choose an account for tax on sales.

rateDialog.description: Any tax at any percentage, with the accounts it posts to.
rateDialog.fixedRate: The rate stays at {{rate}}: entries were taxed at it. For a new percentage, add a new rate.

groupDialog.description: Choose the rates a line charges together.
groupDialog.fixedRates: A group’s rates can’t change: entries were taxed with them. For different rates, add a new group.

gst.ruleSgst: Sales within your state carry CGST + SGST, half the rate each. Sales to other states carry IGST at the full rate.
gst.ruleUtgst: You’re in a Union Territory without a legislature, so sales within it carry CGST + UTGST, half the rate each. Sales elsewhere carry IGST at the full rate.
gst.noStateBody: Add your state in <settings>Settings</settings> so the right tax (SGST or UTGST) is used.
gst.pending: Slabs in force but not set up yet ({{count}}): {{rates}}
gst.setupBody: For each slab, LedgerNest adds a group for sales within your state (CGST + {{local}}) and one for sales to other states (IGST), with the accounts they post to. Anything already set up is kept.
gst.nothingNew: Everything chosen was already set up

errors.name_taken: Another one already has this name.
errors.output_not_liability: Tax on sales goes to a liability account.
errors.input_not_asset: Tax on purchases goes to an asset account (input credit).
errors.same_account: Use different accounts for tax on sales and on purchases.
errors.in_active_group: Active tax groups use this rate. Archive them first.
errors.rate_archived: One of its rates is archived. Restore it first.
errors.rate_not_found: A chosen rate no longer exists.
errors.not_india: GST is for organisations in India. Set the country in Settings, or add your own rates.
errors.no_slabs: Choose at least one GST slab.
errors.code_taken: A GST account code is already used for something else. Change that account’s code, then try again.
errors.overlap: A slab of this rate already applies on some of these dates. Give that one an end date first.
errors.in_use: Organisations use this slab. Give it an end date instead.
errors.slab_not_found: A chosen slab no longer exists.

gstSlabs.title: GST slabs
gstSlabs.description: India’s GST rates that every Indian organisation sets its GST up from. A rate never changes: when the GST Council changes rates, give the old slab an end date and add the new one.
gstSlabs.deleteBody: No organisation uses it, so it will be removed for good.
gstSlabs.newBody: Add a rate the GST Council has notified, with the date it applies from.
gstSlabs.fixedRate: The rate can’t change: entries were taxed at it. To change it, set an end date here and add a new slab.

hints.rate: e.g. 18. Must split evenly into CGST and SGST.
hints.description: What it covers, e.g. most goods and services
hints.effectiveTo: Leave empty while it’s in force.

validation.rate: Enter a rate between 0 and 100 that splits evenly into CGST and SGST.
validation.label: Enter at least 2 characters.
validation.effectiveTo: The end date can’t be before the start date.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: The books are kept in {{base}} ({{name}}). Enable the currencies you trade in and keep their exchange rates here.
currencies.keptManual: Kept the rate typed by hand for {{list}}.
currencies.unsupported: Not covered by the European Central Bank, type these by hand: {{list}}.
currencies.emptyBody: Add one to keep bank accounts, receivables or payables in it. Everything is still reported in {{base}}.
currencies.sourceNote: Fetched rates are the European Central Bank’s daily reference rates, published on working days. A rate you type is never overwritten.
currencies.removeBody: Its exchange rates are removed too. A currency that accounts are kept in can’t be removed.
currencies.noRate: No rate yet: add one before entering amounts in this currency.
currencies.addBody: Amounts in it are converted to {{base}} at the day’s rate.

validation.rate: Enter a rate above 0, with at most 10 decimals.

errors.is_base: That is the base currency: the books are already kept in it.
errors.in_use: Accounts are kept in this currency, so it stays enabled.
errors.source_unavailable: The exchange-rate service couldn’t be reached. Try again later, or type the rates.
errors.currency_not_enabled: Enable this currency under Currencies first.
errors.currency_type: Only asset and liability accounts can be in a foreign currency.

revalue.title: Revalue foreign-currency balances
revalue.body: Every foreign-currency account moves to the day’s rate, and the difference is booked to Unrealised exchange gain or loss in one entry. Do this on a month’s last day, before closing the month.
revalue.dateHint: The day must be in an open month.
revalue.nothing: Balances were already at that day’s rates: nothing to post.
revalue.missing: No rate for {{list}} on that day, so those accounts were left alone.

contacts.title: Customers and vendors
contacts.description: Who you sell to and buy from, with tax IDs, addresses and payment terms.
contacts.search: Search name, email or tax ID
contacts.emptyBody: Add the businesses you invoice and the ones that bill you.
contacts.deleteBody: The contact is removed for good. Once invoices or bills use a contact, archive it instead.

hints.gstin: 15 characters; the state fills in from it.

errors.name_taken: Another contact already has this name.
errors.currency_not_enabled: Enable this currency under Currencies first.

items.description: What you sell and buy, with prices, tax and the accounts they post to.

errors.name_taken: Another item already has this name.
errors.sku_taken: Another item already has this SKU.
errors.income_account_type: Sales of an item go to an income account.
errors.expense_account_type: Purchases of an item go to an expense or asset account.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: What you’ve billed, what’s outstanding and what’s overdue.
invoices.emptyBody: Bill a customer: pick them, add what you sold, and issue.
invoices.draftHint: Drafts can change. Issuing numbers it and posts it to the books.
invoices.voidBody: Its entry is reversed today and the invoice stays on record as void. To bill again, issue a new invoice.
invoices.foreignHint: Billed in {{code}}, to the receivable kept in {{code}}.
invoices.notesPlaceholder: Notes for the customer, e.g. bank details
invoices.deleteBody: It hasn’t been issued, so it will be removed for good.

problems.amounts: Check the highlighted quantities, prices and discounts.

errors.account_required: Choose an income account for every line, or give the item one.
errors.not_income: Invoice lines go to income accounts.
errors.item_archived: A line uses an archived item.
errors.no_receivable_account: There is no receivable account for this currency. Add one to the chart of accounts.
errors.receivable_currency: The receivable must be kept in the invoice’s currency.
errors.zero_total: An invoice must be for more than nothing.

errors.document_entry: This entry belongs to an invoice. Void the invoice instead.

errors.over_allocated: That’s more than the invoice has left to pay.

errors.bank_invalid: Choose an active bank or cash account.
errors.invoice_not_issued: Only issued invoices can be paid.
errors.invoice_currency: An invoice is in a different currency.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Money received from customers and paid to vendors, and the invoices and bills it settled.
payments.emptyBody: Record money a customer paid you, or a payment to a vendor: each settles their invoices or bills.
payments.voidBody: Its entry is reversed today and the invoices it paid are open again.
payments.receiveBody: Money a customer paid you, applied to their invoices. Anything left over stays on their account.
payments.noBank: Add a bank or cash account first
payments.nothingOpen: Nothing left to pay on this customer’s invoices.

problems.bank: Choose the account the money went into.
problems.allocation: Check the highlighted amounts: no more than each invoice has left.
problems.over: You can’t apply more than was received.
problems.allocationPaid: Check the highlighted amounts: no more than each bill has left.
problems.overPaid: You can’t apply more than was paid.

payments.payBody: Money paid to a vendor, applied to their bills. Anything left over is an advance to them.
payments.nothingToPay: Nothing left to pay on this vendor’s bills.
payments.voidPaymentBody: Its entry is reversed today and the bills it paid are open again.

bills.title: Bills
bills.description: What the business owes its vendors: bills to record, pay and keep an eye on.
bills.draftHint: Enter the vendor’s bill as printed. Recording it books the costs, the input GST and what you owe.
bills.emptyBody: Record a vendor’s bill to track what you owe and claim input GST.
bills.voidBody: Its entry is reversed and it no longer counts as owed. This can’t be undone.

problems.account: Choose an account for every line.

errors.not_expense: Bills can only be booked to expense or asset accounts.
errors.no_payable_account: There’s no accounts payable account in this currency. Add one in the chart of accounts.
errors.payable_currency: That payable account is kept in another currency.
errors.not_open: Only bills waiting to be paid can be voided.
errors.bill_not_open: Only recorded bills can be paid.
errors.bill_currency: That bill is in a different currency.
errors.bill_not_found: That bill belongs to another vendor.

creditNotes.title: Credit notes
creditNotes.description: Corrections to issued invoices, and where their credit went.
creditNotes.emptyBody: Open an issued invoice and choose Credit note to take back some or all of it.
creditNotes.createBody: Choose how much of each line to take back. Its tax comes back too, and the credit comes off the invoice first.
creditNotes.offInvoice: All of it comes off what the invoice still has to be paid.
creditNotes.someLeftOver: {{amount}} is more than the invoice has left: the customer keeps it as credit.
creditNotes.applyBody: {{amount}} of credit left to put on another of the customer’s invoices.
creditNotes.refundBody: Pay the remaining credit back to {{name}}.
creditNotes.voidBody: Its entry is reversed today and the invoices it went onto are owed again.

problems.quantity: Check the highlighted quantities: no more than is left on each line.
problems.nothing: Enter a quantity to credit on at least one line.
problems.amount: Check the amount: no more than the credit left or the invoice’s balance.
problems.bank: Choose the account the refund is paid from.

errors.over_credited: That’s more than is left to credit on a line.
errors.line_not_found: A line isn’t on this invoice.
errors.before_invoice: A credit note can’t be dated before its invoice.
errors.over_applied: That’s more credit than is left on this note.
errors.has_refunds: Some of this credit was refunded, so it can’t be voided.
errors.before_credit_note: A refund can’t be dated before its credit note.

recurring.title: Recurring invoices
recurring.description: Invoices that repeat on a schedule, raised from a template.
recurring.emptyBody: Open an invoice and choose Make recurring, or start a schedule here from any invoice.
recurring.pickTemplate: Choose the invoice to repeat: its customer, lines and notes become the template.
recurring.templateFrom: Each invoice goes to {{name}}, with the template’s lines.

fields.name: Name
fields.autoIssue: Issue each invoice as it’s raised

recurring.autoIssueHint: Otherwise each one waits as a draft for you to check and issue.
recurring.deleteBody: It hasn’t raised anything yet, so nothing else changes.
recurring.ranWithFailures: {{raised}} raised, {{failed}} couldn’t be: see the schedules
recurring.dueNow: {{count}} due to raise now; the next run raises them.

problems.count: Enter how many invoices to raise.

errors.not_customer: Invoices are only raised to customers.

banking.description: Your bank and cash accounts: what's in them, what moved, and money in, out and between them.
banking.empty: No bank or cash accounts yet
banking.emptyBody: Add one under Chart of accounts, as an asset of type Bank or Cash.
banking.recordedHint: Money spent, received and transferred from this page.
banking.noneRecorded: Nothing recorded from Banking for this account yet.
banking.voidBody: Its entry is reversed today. It stays on record as void.
banking.spendBody: Money out that isn't a bill: bank charges, fees, owner's drawings. Each line goes to an account, with GST if any.
banking.receiveBody: Money in that isn't an invoice: interest, a refund, a cash sale. Each line goes to an account, with GST if any.
banking.transferBody: Move money between your own accounts. Between currencies, enter what arrived: the difference is an exchange gain or loss.

problems.bank: Choose the bank or cash account.
problems.account: Choose an account for every line.
problems.amount: Enter an amount on every line.

errors.use_documents: Customers and vendors are settled with receipts and payments, so their balances stay right.
errors.same_account: Money can't go to the account it comes from.
errors.tax_foreign: Tax can only be charged on money in the base currency.
errors.account_currency: That account is kept in another currency.
errors.to_amount_required: The accounts are in different currencies: enter what arrived.
errors.to_amount_differs: Both accounts are in the same currency, so the same amount arrives.
errors.no_fx_account: There's no exchange gain or loss account for the difference.
errors.layout_unknown: The columns couldn't be worked out. Choose them below.
errors.nothing_to_import: No transactions could be read from this file.
errors.has_reconciled: Some of these lines are reconciled. Undo that first.

banking.fromBankHint: Import the bank's statement to see its own record here, ready to reconcile.

import.title: Import a statement for {{name}}
import.body: A CSV or OFX file from your bank. Lines already imported are skipped, so overlapping statements are fine.
import.choose: Choose a CSV or OFX file (up to 2 MB)
import.tooBig: Statements can be up to 2 MB.
import.unknownLayout: The columns couldn't be worked out. Choose which column is which: the preview updates as you go.
import.issues: {{count}} rows can't be read and will be left out:
import.undoBody: Its lines are taken out. You can import the file again later.
